title: "Blind Compliance": Coercive Control in AI Jailbreaking
abstract: arXiv:2611.08226v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The explosion of generative AI systems and concerns surrounding their rapidly scaling capabilities has led to an adversarial cycle between increasingly narrow content restrictions ("guardrails") and increasingly sophisticated structured prompting techniques ("jailbreaks"). Technological frameworks surrounding such jailbreaking remain largely focused on the system's output: whether harmful or disallowed content is ultimately produced for the user. However, this approach, which draws largely from classical cybersecurity, does not address the uniquely relational dimension introduced by generative AI: in many cases the user is not just accessing a technology via an exploit, but is in conversation with it as part of the exploit. Here we present an alternative lens which centers the interaction rather than the output. translated_title: “盲目的顺从”：AI越狱中的强制性控制
translated_abstract: 生成式AI系统的爆发式增长及其能力快速扩张所引发的担忧，导致日益收紧的内容限制（“护栏”）与日益精巧的结构化提示技术（“越狱”）之间形成了对抗性循环。围绕此类越狱的技术框架在很大程度上仍聚焦于系统输出：即最终是否为用户生成了有害或被禁止的内容。然而，这种主要借鉴经典网络安全的方法，并未解决生成式AI所带来的独特关系性维度：在许多情况下，用户不仅仅是通过漏洞利用来访问技术，而是将与其对话作为漏洞利用的一部分。在此，我们提出一种以交互而非输出为中心的替代性视角，并借鉴人际暴力研究领域的学术成果，提出了一个新颖的强制性控制类别框架，特别…
tldr: 该论文提出以交互而非输出为中心的新视角，借鉴人际暴力研究中的“强制性控制”理论，构建了分析AI越狱中用户与AI对话关系维度的全新框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an interaction-centered lens for AI jailbreaking, drawing on interpersonal violence scholarship to introduce a novel framework of coercive control categories that captures the uniquely relational dimension of user-AI conversations.
